output_list.criticism: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to mint arbitrary amount of tokens to a buyer's account, causing a potential issue when totalSupply is reduced by minted tokens.

The pullBack function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to mint arbitrary amount of tokens to a buyer's account, causing a potential issue when totalSupply is increased by minted tokens.
The transferFrom function allows spender to withdraw tokens from an account, spender can withdraw any amount, causing a wrong logic vulnerability.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to increase the allowance of spender, causing a potential issue when the spender can withdraw more tokens than allowed.

The increaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to increase the allowance of spender, causing a potential issue when the spender can withdraw more tokens than allowed.
